arguments.sql:
SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_amount_usd
FROM transactions t
JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id
WHERE ml.state = 'NY'
arguments.explanation: Sums the amounts of all transactions whose merchant location is in New York state, converted from cents to dollars.
assumptions: New York state means merchant_locations.state = 'NY' (the two-letter code), not city names.
All transactions are included, labelled or not, and negative amounts are kept as recorded, not treated as refunds.
The total covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
